purpose: R14-C qualification provenance. Every field needed to reproduce the exact treatment.

optillm.approach_override: auto (set per-request via extra_body to prevent none- prepend pass-through)
optillm.known_bug: When --approach none is set, OptiLLM prepends none- to the model name. parse_combined_approach sees approaches[0]=='none' and triggers pass-through, skipping the requested strategy. Fix: set optillm_approach=auto in request extra_body.

STOP.description: Use current state answer, zero cost

OPT_COT_REFLECT.description: Chain-of-thought with reflection: thinking + reflection + output

OPT_SC_LOW.status: RETIRED_FROM_R14C - dominated by COT_REFLECT on accuracy/latency

token_accounting.usage_total_tokens: null for multi-call strategies (cot_reflection, re2, self_consistency, plansearch)
token_accounting.underlying_model_calls: null - OptiLLM does not report internal call count
token_accounting.limitation: R14-C can qualify accuracy vs observed wall latency, but NOT accuracy vs true token/GPU compute. The wall_ms distribution is strongly skewed (e.g. SC: mean 25.4s, median 2.0s), so mean alone is misleading. Report mean, median, p90, p95.

checkpoint_corpus.note: 81 unique task IDs across 90 checkpoints means some tasks appear at multiple K values. All R14-C confidence intervals and hypothesis tests must be task-clustered.

invalidated_results.reason: OptiLLM pass-through bug: no strategy actually executed. All strategies produced identical output with 63.3% accuracy. The 63.3% was the base model pass-through rate, not any strategy result.
